sentences: Microsoft is inviting applications for the position of Principal Product Manager – CoreAI, an exciting full-time employment opportunity based in Redmond, Washington, United States, with an additional work location available.

The opportunity is designed for experienced product management professionals with strong backgrounds in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, developer tools, enterprise software and technology product development.

The successful candidate will join Microsoft’s CoreAI team, contributing to the development and adoption of Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, a platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, manage, debug and deploy intelligent AI agents at scale.
The position offers a competitive annual base salary ranging from $142,800 to $274,800 across most eligible US locations, with a higher salary range applicable to specific metropolitan areas.
Applications are currently being accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
The Principal Product Manager will play an important role in shaping Microsoft’s AI agent platform strategy and supporting enterprise adoption of emerging artificial intelligence technologies.
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service provides developers and organisations with capabilities for building reliable intelligent agents through code-first development and cloud-native services.
The successful candidate will connect customer and market insights with product strategy, helping organisations understand, implement and adopt Microsoft’s AI agent capabilities.
The successful candidate will lead product adoption initiatives, engage with customers and coordinate activities across Microsoft’s engineering, product and commercial teams.
Develop and manage the outbound product strategy for Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, prioritising activities that improve product adoption, customer readiness and measurable business outcomes.
Work directly with enterprise customers, technology partners, internal product adopters and field teams to identify challenges affecting product adoption.
Customer feedback and recurring technical issues will be translated into product recommendations and roadmap priorities.
Build and use intelligent agents on Microsoft’s platform to create technically credible demonstrations, reference scenarios, tutorials and product narratives.
Collaborate with engineering, product design, marketing, documentation, support and sales teams to coordinate product launches, customer feedback processes and adoption programmes.
Develop clear technical explanations demonstrating how developers can move from code-based workflows to cloud deployment using GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Azure and Foundry Agent Service.
Use product telemetry, customer evidence and qualitative feedback to evaluate adoption initiatives and recommend improvements.
These improvements may focus on reliability, security, scalability and developer experience.
Represent customer and developer needs during product planning while maintaining clear distinctions between product management, marketing and sales responsibilities.
